Mussolini pulled his weenie, and now it doesn't work."   And were admonished by Mrs. Goodnight to never sing that again in the play shed  or at school.  Ever.    Things don't really change.  Truman got beat up by Republicans,  ever dismayed that their "shoo-in" Governor Dewey (R) was beaten by Truman (D).    Not much new in politics.  Oh,  and we had the Red under every bed,  and it turns out that many really were communists in Hollywood.  The Rosenburgs stole atomic secrets and were executed.
Silly, grandstanding woman whose 15 minutes were a long, long time ago.
